name: Towards Load-Aware Prefill Deflection for Disaggregated LLM Serving (arXiv 2607.02043)
notes: Microsoft Research paper on prefill deflection for disaggregated serving. Key finding: prefill execution is only 2-23% of P95 TTFT; queue wait and KV transfer dominate. Kairos reduces P95 TTFT by up to 81%. The arXiv HTML was fetched and verified.
